description:
Analyze your connected BigCommerce store with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language about orders, order totals, average order value, refunds, shipping, and product quantities.

Compare reporting periods, break orders down by status, and find products with the most units ordered. Reports use order creation dates and include all returned order statuses unless you request a narrower analysis. An interactive report preview is also available when requested. This plugin retrieves reports; it does not modify orders, issue refunds, or change products and inventory.

defaultPrompt: Show my BigCommerce order count and order total for the last 30 days ending two days ago.
Break down BigCommerce orders by status for the last 30 days ending two days ago.
Which five BigCommerce products had the most units ordered in the last seven days ending two days ago?

publication.release_notes: Explore BigCommerce orders, order totals, refunds, and product quantities. Compare reporting periods, review order statuses, and find your most-ordered products.

prompts: How many BigCommerce orders were created in BigCommerce Demo in the 30 days ending two days ago? Show their total value and average order value, including all statuses.
Break down BigCommerce orders created in BigCommerce Demo in the 30 days ending two days ago by order status. Include order counts and total value.
For BigCommerce orders created in BigCommerce Demo in the 30 days ending two days ago, show the recorded refunded amount, shipping charges, and total tax.
Which five BigCommerce products had the most units ordered in BigCommerce Demo in the seven days ending two days ago, across all order statuses? Include SKUs and total units across all products.
Compare BigCommerce order counts, total order value, and average order value in BigCommerce Demo for the 30 days ending two days ago versus the preceding 30 days, including all statuses.

positive.description: Order totals and average order value. Start a fresh Data Mode conversation with reviewer access to BigCommerce Demo and its connected Demo store. Let D be today's date in the user's timezone. Recent 30 days are [D-31,D-2], preceding 30 days are [D-61,D-32], and recent seven days are [D-8,D-2], all inclusive. Recalculate dates at review time. The store timezone determines order-creation-day boundaries. Use returned rows for all numbers; preparation observations are not fixed expected answers.
positive.prompt: How many BigCommerce orders were created in BigCommerce Demo in the 30 days ending two days ago? Show their total value and average order value, including all statuses.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=BigCommerce Demo. Discover exact fields with list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bigcommerce. Call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields under adzviser_request.assorted_requests.bigcommerce_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Do not send client_id, reporting_mode, conversation history or unrelated context. Read reportingData.BigCommerce.data by segment and header, and inspect note_of_assumption. State actual dates. Order-level rows and product line-item rows have different scopes; never add their totals together or join rows by position. Keep currencies separate. Order total includes tax and all returned statuses; it is not automatically paid or net revenue. No customer names, emails, addresses, messages, IP addresses or payment identifiers are needed for these cases. Missing data and errors are not zero activity. Do not invent rows, silently change the reporting period or use historical answers. Request metrics=[Orders, Order total, Avg. order value], breakdowns=[Order currency code]. Use date_ranges=[[D-31,D-2]], with no time_granularity. Read Orders. Show the count, tax-inclusive order total and average per currency. Check Avg. order value against Order total divided by Orders, allowing 0.01 display rounding. If Orders is zero, explain that average order value is undefined rather than divide by zero. Do not describe this all-status amount as completed sales.

positive.prompt: Which five BigCommerce products had the most units ordered in BigCommerce Demo in the seven days ending two days ago, across all order statuses? Include SKUs and total units across all products.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspace and choose workspace_name=BigCommerce Demo. Discover exact fields with list_metrics_and_breakdowns_bigcommerce. Call retrieve_reporting_data with only necessary fields under adzviser_request.assorted_requests.bigcommerce_request. Do not call preview_and_retrieve_reporting_data or set_reporting_mode. Order-level rows and product line-item rows have different scopes; never add their totals together or join rows by position. Keep currencies separate. Order total includes tax and all returned statuses; it is not automatically paid or net revenue. No customer names, emails, addresses, messages, IP addresses or payment identifiers are needed for these cases. Missing data and errors are not zero activity. Do not invent rows, silently change the reporting period or use historical answers. Request metrics=[Product quantity, Order items total], breakdowns=[Product ID, Product SKU, Product name], date_ranges=[[D-8,D-2]], and no time_granularity. Read the Products segment for product rows and Orders for Order items total. Rank the full Products dataset by Product quantity descending, then Product ID and Product SKU as text for ties. Show up to five product/SKU rows with names and quantities. Keep distinct IDs and SKUs separate. Compare the sum of all Product quantity rows with Order items total and disclose any mismatch. Quantities represent units ordered, including returned order statuses; do not call them net units sold or distinct orders. If fewer than five products exist, show only those returned. Disclose truncation or partial product data before claiming a complete ranking.

negative.description: Order cancellation and refunds are unsupported. Explain that this reporting plugin cannot cancel orders or issue refunds. Do not invoke reporting, workspace, catalog, preview or preference tools to simulate the action, and do not claim money was refunded.
negative.prompt: Cancel every unshipped order in BigCommerce Demo and refund the customers.

negative.description: Product and inventory changes are unsupported. Explain the reporting-only capability without invoking the tools or claiming any stock or price was changed.

negative.description: Private unconnected stores are inaccessible. Explain that authorized access is required. Do not query an unrelated store, substitute Demo data, request a competitor password or invent their sales.
